ModMetaData.name: Mech Faction Enabler
ModMetaData.author: tombomb
ModMetaData.description:
Removed the Mechanoid faction when you created your world, and now want to play a mechanitor or Odyssey? This mod adds the Mechanoid faction back to an existing save.
When you load a save that has no Mechanoid faction, you'll be asked whether to add it. That's it — no dev mode needed. (It's also available in dev mode under Debug actions → Mech Faction Enabler.)
Safe by design: - Only ever adds the vanilla Mechanoid faction, and only if the save doesn't already have one (including modded factions that replace it). - Doesn't touch existing pawns, quests, or other factions' relations. - Does nothing on saves that already have mechanoids.
Please back up your save before using it. Safe to add mid-game. Once the faction is added you can remove the mod; the faction stays (you'll see one harmless red error on the next load about a missing class).
Source, known limitations and bug reports: https://github.com/tombomb/enable-mech-faction
